scenario.summary: Guest searches an active news by its SEO page title (title: CMS pages listed with news) and verifies the CMS search result shows its title and description.
steps: Open the webstore (or click the logo)
Search with the record's SEO page title
Verify the CMS search results tab, open it
Verify the result's page title and description
assertions: Search result shows the record's SEO title and description
evidence: NEW key BLOG_NEWS_SEARCHABLE_OF_STORE (pending): an active blog or news of the store (ZnodeBlogNews, BlogNewsType Blog/News) published (ZnodePublishBlogNewsEntity), inside its activation/expiration dates, with SEO title and description (ZnodeCMSSEODetail/Locale), so the storefront CMS search finds it by title, description or content. No existing key covers blogs/news; entity map blog_news and query written 2026-11-10 (pending; SEO title/description via ZnodeCMSSEODetail SEOCode = BlogNewsCode on the same portal, type BlogNews). MaxwellsHardware (PortalId 7) has Shopify / CordlessWoodworkingBlog / BlogWithInactiveContentPage blogs and NewYorkTimes / SampleNews news. Guest flow, no sign-in.

news = BLOG_NEWS_SEARCHABLE_OF_STORE {"store": "MaxwellsHardware", "blogNewsType": "News", "withSeoDescription": true}; preferred the sheet title (cmsBasedSearchData/NewYorkNews/SEOPageTitle), not required.
Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware), the same store as the Selenium pdp/quickOrder entries.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json has no observations for these Selenium cells (profiled false); DB facts from bin/tda rows (2026-11-10) where cited.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, map key prefixes, regex) are framework constants: role config, no need.
